title: HeartBound Skills
description: A dynamic fantasy RPG leveling mod! Train 5 core skills, unlock perks via a custom menu, and face vanilla mobs that scale with your combat level.
body:
# HeartBound Skills

HeartBound Skills is a dynamic fantasy RPG leveling mod that rewards you for playing Minecraft your way! Every action you take—whether you are mining deep underground, fighting off monsters, or exploring distant lands—earns you experience and brings you closer to ultimate power.

---

## Features

- **Earn XP Naturally:** Get experience by mining blocks, killing mobs, exploring biomes, and more.

- **Level Up & Progress:** Accumulate enough XP to raise your character level and earn valuable skill points.

- **Unlock Skills:** Press **K** at any time to open a custom RPG skill tree menu and spend your hard-earned points.

- **Train 5 Core Attributes:** Invest your points into **Health, Mining, Combat, Speed, and Farming** to permanently boost your stats.

- **Dynamic World Scaling:** Beware! As you level up your Combat skill, the World Tier rises. Vanilla mobs will automatically become stronger to match your power.

- **Quests & Currency:** Take on challenges with the new Quest system and earn money through the integrated Currency system.

---

## How It Works

1. **Perform Actions:** Just play the game! Go mining, hunting, or traveling to collect points.

2. **Open the Menu:** Press **K** on your keyboard at any time to open your custom skill tree.

3. **Customize Your Character:** Spend your points and choose the perks that best fit your playstyle.

4. **Do Quests & Earn Cash:** Complete quests to build up your wealth for future updates.

---
